script.description: JavaScript expression to evaluate in the page context

session_id.description: Existing browser session id (required after open)

text.description: Text to type into the selector

function.name: canvas

action.description: Canvas action: create, upsert_block, move_block, delete_block, render

after_block_id.description: Optional anchor block id used for ordering

kind.description: Block kind, for example note or checklist

function.description: Exercise the Supernova syscall gateway as a one-shot facade for formal kernel operations
function.name: gateway

action.description: Gateway action: describe, spawn_agent, kill_agent, read_world, write_world, read_file, write_file, schedule, cancel_schedule, get_budget, emit_event

agent_id.description: Optional synthetic agent id for the one-shot gateway call

register_agent.description: Whether to register the synthetic agent before invoking the syscall

pid.description: Target process id for info or kill

function.description: List repositories for the authenticated GitHub user
function.name: github

language.description: Optional language filter, for example Gleam or Rust

updated_since.description: Optional ISO date or timestamp filter, for example 2026-03-01

function.description: Read-only git operations: status, log, branch, diff, show
function.name: git_inspect

action.description: Action: status, log, branch, diff, show

function.description: Read, write, and list the files you keep for your person, within your workspace. Your core and internal state are not reachable.
function.name: file_system

function.description: Schedule something your person asked you to do later, once or on a recurring basis; at that time you will be woken with the request and your reply goes to your person. Also list or remove what is scheduled. Times are in the local time shown as "Agora" in your context. Schedule only what your person asked for.
function.name: agenda

request.description: For add: what to do at that time, written as instructions to yourself.

when.description: For add: a local date and time "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM" for once, or a 5-field cron expression (minute hour day month weekday) for recurring, e.g. "0 5 * * *" for every day at 05:00. At most once an hour.

function.description: Search everything your person and you have said to each other, in every chat, beyond the recent messages you see. Returns excerpts: each matching message (marked ») with the message before it and the two after it, with date, time and who said it, since the answer is often in the next message. Use it when asked about something said earlier, or to check what was actually said, instead of guessing. If the first words find nothing useful, try others. Finding nothing means it was not said, or was forgotten with /esquecer.
function.name: buscar_conversa

terms.description: Words to look for. A message matches when it contains all of them; case and accents are ignored.
